planets.name: WASP-2 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-2 with a 2.15-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: WASP-2 b was found in 2007 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-2. Its orbit and size follow Addison et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ADDISON_ET_AL__2019): disc_year 2007, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.15222216, pl_radj 1.081, pl_bmassj 0.931

quotes.title: WASP-2b
quotes.card: WASP-2b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star WASP-2 located about 500 light years away in the constellation of Delphinus.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered via the transit method, and then follow up measurements using the radial velocity method confirmed that WASP-2b was a planet.
